purpose: Define mandatory prompting standards for generated applications produced by the factory.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Highly modular design
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications must separate API, contracts, domain logic, services, adapters, validation, tests, observability, operations, and evidence concerns.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Industry standard software life cycle coverage
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications must include requirements traceability, architecture/design intent, implementation, tests, validation, evaluation, security, observability, operations, and release-readiness evidence.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Near-certifiable quality posture
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications should be reviewable against certification-like quality evidence without claiming actual certification or official compliance.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Mocked surrounding ecosystem
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: All out-of-scope upstream and downstream dependencies must remain explicit mocks unless separately approved and evidenced.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Ports and adapters
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: External ecosystem interactions must go through explicit interfaces and replaceable mock adapters.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: API and data contracts
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: API requests, responses, errors, state transitions, and domain objects must be explicit, typed, and testable.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Validation and evaluation
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications must include deterministic validation and quality evaluation criteria beyond syntax or happy-path tests.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Observability and operational readiness
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications must include health/readiness today and should evolve toward logs, metrics, traces, correlation IDs, troubleshooting, and runbooks.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Security and testability
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated applications must validate inputs, avoid unsafe defaults, avoid secret leakage, preserve mock boundaries, and include unit/API/contract/negative/boundary/regression tests.

minimum_generated_application_standard.name: Beginner-readable and debug-friendly maintainability
minimum_generated_application_standard.expectation: Generated code must prefer clear names, small functions, simple control flow, actionable errors, and easy debugging over clever abstractions.
